title: Attack-window LP recovery TagDuel adapter

cards.name: Draining Shield
cards.officialText: If an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate that attack, and if you do, gain LP equal to that target's ATK.

cards.name: Enchanted Javelin
cards.officialText: Increase your Life Points by the ATK of 1 attacking monster.

behavior.sharedWindow: Response to attack declaration, before the Damage Step; source must be Set since a prior turn and controller must hold response priority.

drainingShield.lpGain: Current ATK of the still-valid targeted attacker, only if the attack is negated.

enchantedJavelin.lpGain: Current ATK of one monster that is still attacking when the Trap resolves.

behavior.chainRules: Both are Normal Traps; they cannot be chained over a Spell Speed 3 Counter Trap. An already-cancelled attack cannot generate recovery.
behavior.ownership: LP are added to the shared team controlled by the Trap activator. The Trap's physical UID and owner seat are retained; after resolution it moves to the physical owner's team Graveyard.
behavior.downstream: A unique m574:<activationId> event is emitted in the Fire Princess LP-gain event shape. The adapter does not invoke Fire Princess or alter the central engine.

invariantCoverage: hand limit 6 checked at End Phase by the rules profile
three shared Monster Zones and three shared Spell/Trap Zones per team
separate Field Zone and Extra Deck maximum five
current ATK at resolution, not activation-time snapshot
physical owner seat separated from current team controller
idempotent activation IDs and LIFO chain resolution
safe integer LP overflow and non-negative LP validation

certification.reason: M574 is an isolated behavior adapter; central resolver, card metadata, certification fingerprints and released-card allowlist were not changed.
